Engineering task: Structuring the M1 artefact set against the Milestone 1 brief and Master Project Brief
AI contribution: Produced a candidate artefact list, section structure for the PED, and initial identifier scheme.
Human verification: Each proposed section was tested against the brief requirements. The artefact list was validated against the acceptance criteria and the PED structure reviewed for completeness.
Decision: Accept and use as the baseline architecture. All subsequent sections aligned to this structure.
Issues found: None; proposal was well-structured and complete.

Engineering task: Drafting candidate functional and non-functional requirements from the CivicConnect scenario
AI contribution: Generated a candidate requirement set with draft acceptance criteria. Proposal included 25 functional and 18 non-functional requirements with measurable criteria.
Human verification: Each requirement was checked for traceability to the scenario brief, testability against acceptance criteria, and consistency with stakeholder needs. Secondary model cross-check performed on measurability.
Decision: Accept and refine. Nine NFRs rewritten for measurability. Scope reduced to 26 FR and 14 NFR for M1 baseline.
Issues found: Nine NFRs initially stated unmeasurable criteria (fast, secure, user-friendly). All rewritten with explicit metrics and verification methods. AI-003 found FR-001 stated no concurrency or data volume limits.

Engineering task: Independent critique of the draft requirement set for testability
AI contribution: Reviewed each acceptance criterion and flagged those that were not objectively verifiable or measurable. Identified missing concurrency and data volume constraints.
Human verification: Findings reviewed by Don against the scenario requirements. Each flagged criterion re-examined and acceptance criteria rewritten with explicit metrics.
Decision: Accept the critique. All flagged requirements revised and added to RTM.
Issues found: Acceptance criteria in NFR-001, 002, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 013, 014 were initially unmeasurable. AI review identified all nine. All now include numbers and verification methods.

Engineering task: Drafting the risk register and forward engineering considerations
AI contribution: Generated candidate risks with probability and impact ratings. Proposed 12 risks covering technical, process and team dimensions.
Human verification: Generic entries such as 'project will fail' were rejected. Each risk was re-evaluated by the team for specificity, cause, owner and mitigation/contingency distinction. Team added RSK-04 (approval deadlock in 3-person team) after review.
Decision: Accept with team additions and re-scoring. RSK-04 added and accepted; others scored by consensus.
Issues found: Generic language in initial proposals. RSK-04 identified as missing by the team during review — represents a genuine governance hazard in a 3-person team requiring dual approval. Mitigated through 24-hour review turnaround (DEC-010).

Engineering task: Drafting the GitHub governance procedure and pull request template
AI contribution: Produced branch protection settings, a commit convention and a review checklist.
Human verification: Each setting was checked against the project rules, tested by attempting a direct push to main and a self-approval (both refused), and verified in the repository settings panel.
Decision: Accept and implement. All protections enabled and verified.
Issues found: None; all proposed controls successfully implemented and tested.

Engineering task: Analysis of stakeholder conflicts and scope exclusion rationale
AI contribution: Proposed conflict pairings and candidate resolutions. Identified five genuine conflicts and proposed scope boundaries to manage each.
Human verification: Each proposed conflict was tested against the stakeholder statements and scenario brief. Resolutions checked for feasibility and alignment with project constraints.
Decision: Accept and use as baseline. Five genuine conflicts identified with resolutions; scope split into 12 in-scope, 9 exclusions, 6 deferrals.
Issues found: None; conflict identification was accurate and resolutions were feasible.

Engineering task: Verification of issue #6 closure status and signature completeness in M1-baseline-signoff.md
AI contribution: Reviewed the mismatch between marked-complete checkboxes and baseline acceptance criteria. Identified three items marked Done where evidence was incomplete.
Human verification: Human re-examination of the three flagged items confirmed the mismatch. Acceptance criteria re-checked against actual evidence. Issue #6 resolved; baseline signoff updated with verified completion status.
